One week in the University (family)

You’re already welcome here—print what helps; skip the rest without guilt.

Same morning reset as Family Armor for little ones every day—then evenings 1–4 match Evening in the University. Days 5–7 circle back in a quiet way so the week can rest without a fifth “new” assignment. Save progress in Battle Plans on this device if you use the same path.

Day 1

Morning — Lamentations 3:22–23; Psalm 5:3. Short prayer: thank God for breath, order, and love you did not earn—one honest start, no score.

Evening — Deuteronomy 6:6–7 (teach, talk, sit, walk, lie down, rise). Ask: “What did you hear?” One answer is enough. Pray once.

Day 2

Morning — same Lamentations / Psalm 5 pattern as day 1.

Evening — Psalm 4:8. Lay down in peace; the LORD makes safety. Hush one extra screen if you can.

Day 3

Morning — same morning reset.

Evening — Luke 24:29 (“Abide with us”). Name kindly if someone’s day felt “far spent.”

Day 4

Morning — same morning reset.

Evening — Matthew 11:28–30. Come, learn, find rest—smallest voice may read a phrase or only listen. Amen.

Day 5

Morning — same morning reset.

Evening — Psalm 4:8 again—peace and sleep; no new text, just the same hush. Thank God for one mercy from the day.

Day 6

Morning — same morning reset.

Evening — Deuteronomy 6:6–7 again—words in the heart, teach in ordinary hours. One short “What did you hear?”

Day 7

Morning — same morning reset.

Evening — Matthew 11:28 (first line)—come to Christ for rest. No speech needed if you are all spent: sit, breathe, one amen.

Optional: if you start a new week, keep the same morning and run evenings 1–4 from the top, or open any course you already saved on this device.
